properties.evidence: The cause behind Alex's report. `ensure_server_async` attaches to any live rendezvous for the right graph without ever reading the version it publishes, so a client of version X attaches to a daemon of version Y by design rather than by accident. `basis: causal` because the mechanism is read out of the attach path rather than inferred from correlation; `validation_status: hypothesis` because the discriminating test — a client refusing or re-electing on a version mismatch — has not been built or run.
